/2025/09/chaupadi.html.caption: चार दिनको गोठ, पाँचौँ दिन फेरि देवी बन्नुपर्ने अभिनय।

/2025/05/echoes-of-faded-love.html.caption: Two ghosts of light crossing the same pale sky, and poems written against forgetting.
/2025/05/echoes-of-faded-love.html.description: A poetry film of 'echoes of faded love.' by Basava (बासभ). Two people who were never possessions of each other, two ghosts of light in the same sky, and poems written to keep a memory alive a little longer.
/2025/05/echoes-of-faded-love.html.alt: Title frame of the poetry film 'echoes of faded love.': pale evening light.
